lifecycles._note: NEW API wave 2026-07-15 (SPEC-DIFF-20260715 §3): 5 of the 6 new servicewatch 1.4 endpoints — listalerts / listnamespacebyalerts / showalertlevelcountsbyservice (bare-account reads, all 200 live 2026-07-15) + listalertnotifications / setalertnotifications (alert-bound: a free alert is created for the ids). LIVE RESULTS 2026-07-15: listalerts 200, listnamespacebyalerts 200, showalertlevelcountsbyservice 200 (returns per-namespace HIGH/MIDDLE/LOW counts for ALL namespaces even with zero alerts), createalert 201, listalertnotifications 200 (empty list), setalertnotifications 400/500 (see step note — cannot reach 2xx in this account: recipients must be IAM users and the account has ZERO IAM users, listiamuser count:0), deletebulkalerts 200, show-after-delete 404. BREAKING BEHAVIOR CHANGE vs servicewatch 1.3 (affects the OLDER servicewatch-alert lifecycle, NOT modified here — hand-off): createalert now REJECTS a body without a dimension — 400 ValidationError 'At least one dimension must be set.' even though AlertCreateRequest marks dimension/dimensions optional (docs-vs-runtime mismatch, conformance candidate). Fix = send dimension {key,value} copied verbatim from the metric catalog entry: POST /v1/metrics -> namespaces[].dimensions[].metrics[].dimensions[0] carries a REAL {key:resource_id,value:<uuid>} pair per metric-emitting resource.

steps.name: list-alerts
steps._note: listalerts (NEW 1.4): unconditional 200, {alerts:[],count:0,page,size,sort} on a bare account. 12 optional query filters (name/activated_yn/states/levels/namespace_ids/...).

steps.name: list-namespaces-by-alerts
steps._note: listnamespacebyalerts (NEW 1.4): 200 live, {count:0,namespaces:[]} with zero alerts. No query params.

steps.name: show-alert-level-counts
steps._note: showalertlevelcountsbyservice (NEW 1.4): 200 live. Returns level_counts[] for EVERY known namespace (apigateway, archivestorage, ...) with zeroed HIGH/MIDDLE/LOW even when the account has no alerts.

steps.name: list-metric-catalog
steps._note: listmetricinfos POST-as-read (constraint metric-posts-are-queries). NEW vs the older servicewatch-alert lifecycle: ALSO soft-captures the metric's real dimension {key,value} pair (metrics[].dimensions[0]) because createalert 1.4 requires >=1 dimension at runtime. Requires at least one metric-emitting resource in the account (live 2026-07-15: 9 namespaces present).

steps.name: create-alert
steps._note: createalert with the runtime-required dimension: 201 live 2026-07-15 (flat response {id,created_at,created_by}). WITHOUT dimension: 400 'At least one dimension must be set.' — docs mark it optional (conformance candidate).

steps.name: list-alert-notifications
steps._note: listalertnotifications (NEW 1.4): 200 live on a fresh alert — {alert_notifications:[],count:0,page,size,sort}. Optional filters size/page/sort/user_name.

steps.name: set-alert-notifications
steps._note: setalertnotifications (NEW 1.4) — 2xx UNREACHABLE in this account (live 2026-07-15): recipients must be IAM users (400 ValidationError, detail in the request_id field(!): 'Only IAM users can be added as alert recipients.') and listiamuser returns count:0 for this account. Sent with the doc-sample uuid -> deterministic 400 records write coverage. DO NOT send user_ids:[] — empty array is a live-observed 500 ContactAdminForAssistance (backend bug candidate for the conformance axis / known_issues baseline). Promote to a real 2xx once an IAM user exists (then also verify list shows the recipient). Separate group so its 4xx never skips teardown.

steps.name: delete-alerts
steps._note: deletebulkalerts: 200 live {ids:[...]}. Post-delete GET /v1/alerts/{id} 404 ResourceNotFound (verified — no lingering alert).

lifecycles._note: NEW API wave 2026-07-15 (SPEC-DIFF-20260715 §3): createloggroupexporttask (POST /v1/log-groups/export-tasks, NEW 1.4) — MODELED ONLY (provenance: docs), NOT live-validated. Blocker: LogGroupExportTaskCreateRequest requires a REAL Object Storage bucket_name (all 5 fields REQUIRED: bucket_name, log_group_id, log_stream_ids[], start_at, end_at) and this session's scope forbids creating OBS buckets; the account also has zero log groups (GET /v1/log-groups count:0 live 2026-07-15). The log-group + log-stream prereqs ARE self-serve free (see servicewatch-log-group lifecycle, VALIDATED) — only the bucket gates this. ENABLE PATH: create/borrow an OBS bucket, set bucket_name to it (replace the regrexport{unique} placeholder), flip enabled:true, run, record the response envelope $.log_group_export.{id,state,...} (per doc response_example). Response likely async (completed_at field). Export task delete endpoint NOT present in the 1.4 catalog — task rows appear immutable history (no teardown step needed for the task itself).

steps.name: create-log-group
steps._note: Same recipe as the VALIDATED servicewatch-log-group lifecycle — free.

steps.name: create-log-group-export-task
steps._note: createloggroupexporttask (NEW 1.4): all 5 body fields REQUIRED per LogGroupExportTaskCreateRequest. bucket_name here is a PLACEHOLDER — a nonexistent bucket will 4xx; substitute a real OBS bucket to reach 2xx (see lifecycle _note enable path).
